purpose: Keep non-terminal owners doing useful work by chaining bounded work units until the 10-minute target, then close at the next safe boundary with a verified same-canonical continuation.

pre_final_authorization.authorization_rule: Honor operator pause and terminal states first. Otherwise apply turn_decision and all bounded close requirements; verified continuation alone is never sufficient.

turn_decision.clock: Observed authorized work start through close; elapsed is NOT useful-work duration. Capture wake time separately; startup must not reset the platform safety budget.
order: Honor operator pause/STOP before work and scheduler mutation.
After each completed bounded unit, choose the next primary, independent fallback, then smallest authorized runnable unit.
If elapsed <600s and a clear low-risk checkpointable unit fits the remaining platform safety budget, execute it in the same turn.
If elapsed <600s and the obvious next unit is too large, decompose it and execute a smaller safe slice when possible.
A CONTINUE close below 600s requires a concrete documented reason and alternatives_checked; below 480s additionally requires an allowlisted short-turn exception.
At elapsed >=600s, do not start a new large unit; finish only the smallest safe in-flight unit.
Aim to close by ~720s; exceeding that soft ceiling requires an actual in-flight safety/atomicity reason.
Checkpoint, set normal same-canonical due to actual END+60s unless an explicit durable exception applies, validate the run record, then report.
turn_decision.close_reserve_rule: Use measured close cost only to avoid overrunning the platform safety budget. Do not use reserve as a reason to stop before 600s when another small safe unit fits. Never pad.
normal_close_evidence: alternatives_checked and short_turn_reason when closing below 600 seconds
allowlisted exception evidence when closing below 480 seconds
turn_decision.pause_rule: state/NOW.json execution_status=PAUSED forbids new work and self-rearm; checkpoint only and report PAUSED.

work_unit_chaining.before_target: When a bounded unit completes before 600 elapsed seconds, start the next clear low-risk checkpointable authorized unit if it fits the remaining platform safety budget.
work_unit_chaining.decompose_if_needed: If the obvious next unit is too large or risky, select a smaller safe slice with an explicit checkpoint.
work_unit_chaining.after_target: At or after 600 elapsed seconds, do not start a new large unit; finish only the smallest safe in-flight unit, checkpoint, verify continuation, and close.
work_unit_chaining.soft_ceiling: Normal operation should close by about 720 elapsed seconds. Exceed only for a genuine in-flight atomicity/safety reason.
